title: Exhaust verifier freshness capacity
preconditions: the verifier enforces explicit finite total, publisher, account, and issuance-rate limits
one or more unexpired challenge records remain live
steps: request challenges until one configured capacity or rate boundary is reached
request one additional challenge while the existing records remain unexpired
inspect the previously registered records after the refusal
invariants: capacity exhaustion never evicts an unexpired replay record
capacity exhaustion never enables stateless challenge verification
residual_risk: sustained issuance pressure can cause a fail-closed protected-mode outage
